listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (nxport)
listing.summary: The nxport builder creates a Mac or iOS app from your own extracted Tears of the Kingdom files. The project reports testing both platforms, with rendering flicker, terrain defects and audio problems. There is no ready-made download or confirmed game revision.
listing.original_game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own extracted ExeFS, RomFS and Logo. The project has not confirmed which game version, region or title ID this profile accepts.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Build nxport-builder from source, choose Tears of the Kingdom and select the Mac or iOS target to produce a local app or IPA. You handle preparation and later rebuilds.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports problems with terrain lighting and Rauru’s audio. The builder targets Apple silicon. There is no confirmed Windows or Linux player.
